senses.gloss:
दौहित्र दौहित्र, अस्, m. (fr. दुहितृ), a
daughter's son; a term applied to a rhinoceros; (ई),
f. a daughter's daughter; (अम्), n. sesamum-seed;
ghee from a brownish cow (?) .
—दौहित्र-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, having or possessing a daughter's son.

दौहित्रक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a daughter's
son.
दौहित्रायण, अस्, m. the son of a daughter's son.

दौहृद दौहृद, अम्, n. (see दौर्हृद),
the longing or desire of pregnant women for certain
things, pregnancy; [cf. दोहद.]

दौहृदिनी, f. a woman who has the longing
which attends pregnancy, a pregnant woman.
